name: Kadokura Eiji
source:
Kou's father and the leader of the notorious mercenary group, Fenrir. To Kou, he is the father who abandoned his own wife to a disorder in the pursuit of riches, and they have a strained relationship.

He pilots the Simulacrum "Nidhogg".
